checkpoint: CP7 ARCHITECT / REASONING / AGENTIC MODEL CHALLENGERS
scope: Offline challenger-benchmark harness only; no production routing or account configuration changes.

inventory.solBenchmarkStatus: blocked: recorded Codex weekly quota was 6%, below the 15% starting safety threshold

reasons: Qualitative scoring was permissive keyword matching and did not establish all required invariants.
Full qualitative outputs and complete agentic source-only diffs were not retained.
Cached successes and retried failures produced asymmetric attempt handling.
Documented timeout semantics did not match the implementation.
The resulting report overstated hard-reasoning correctness.

harnessRemediation.pathContainment: Uses path.relative-based containment rather than prefix matching.
harnessRemediation.agenticWriteBoundary: Permits writes and patches only under src/; public tests, hidden tests, and package metadata are immutable.
harnessRemediation.reasoning: Known omission traps require positive evidence rather than defaulting to avoided; deterministic diagnostics remain provisional and require manual invariant review before any success or role conclusion.
harnessRemediation.qualitative: Retains full output, SHA-256 hash, evaluator version, and marks output provisional pending manual invariant review.
harnessRemediation.agenticEvidence: Retains source-only worktree diff and SHA-256 hash with public/hidden test outcomes.
harnessRemediation.attemptPolicy: Uses append-only attempt files; no cached success reuse.
harnessRemediation.sessionDeadline: Enforces an eight-minute wall-clock deadline for each agentic session.

verification.focusedHarnessTests: npx vitest run test/benchmark-cp7.test.ts: passed (14 tests)

verdict: BENCHMARK_INCOMPLETE. No model role, default, or production change may be justified from CP7 until the matrix is rerun with the remediated harness and independently reviewed.
